name: Date Helper
desc: Manipulate, format, and extract time units for all your date and time needs.

actions.name: format_date
actions.description: Converts a date from one format to another

actions.name: extract_date_parts
actions.description: Pull year, month, day, weekday and more out of a date

actions.name: date_difference
actions.description: Get the difference between two dates

actions.name: add_subtract_date
actions.description: Add or subtract time from a date

actions.name: next_day_of_week
actions.description: Get the date and time of the next day of the week

actions.name: next_day_of_year
actions.description: Get the date and time of the next day of the year

actions.name: first_day_of_previous_month
actions.description: Get the date and time of the first day of the previous month

actions.name: last_day_of_previous_month
actions.description: Get the date and time of the last day of the previous month
